principles: Authored CANDIDATE is not historical recovery.
A valid curriculum use does not by itself promote language authority or productivity.
A stale rationale or stale phonological annotation does not automatically invalidate the candidate form; it creates review debt.
Dependencies on GATE/WATCH/unresolved assets must remain machine-visible.
No candidate may be promoted to broader productivity while a material upstream dependency remains unresolved.

disposition_model.KEEP: Candidate survives A1-A7 with no material rationale defect; remains CANDIDATE unless separately promoted.
disposition_model.KEEP_SCOPED: Candidate remains useful and supported only inside its current governed scope; no global productivity.
disposition_model.REVIEW: Candidate may remain registered, but at least one rationale, phonology, semantics or dependency claim requires explicit re-review.
disposition_model.UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENCY: Candidate depends materially on a GATE/WATCH/unresolved asset or unapproved rule; no authority/productivity promotion before dependency resolution.
disposition_model.RATIONALE_WEAKENED: The candidate can remain as authorship, but the prior corpus-facing derivation no longer carries its original evidentiary weight.
disposition_model.RETIREMENT_CANDIDATE: Noncanonical proposal should be archived/superseded unless re-justified after upstream decisions.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: The authored registry is generally well-governed: all 20 entries are CANDIDATE and explicitly deny historical recovery.
cross_candidate_findings.implication: A8 recommends targeted repair, not registry reset.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: The strongest surviving evidence-mapped candidates are AN, EN, KU, KE, ZAMI and KALA, but all remain scoped.
cross_candidate_findings.implication: Do not use course repetition to promote them globally.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: KUVAN survives better as a closed authored specialization than as proof of productive KU+VAN morphology.
cross_candidate_findings.implication: Keep candidate/closed until -VAN and interrogative architecture decisions are explicit.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: KUON is the highest dependency-risk registered candidate because ON remains GATE and the earlier compositional rule explicitly excluded KU+ON.
cross_candidate_findings.implication: No broader use or promotion until a superseding B15 decision resolves the dependency.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: VALA is the strongest semantic-rationale debt: the form can remain authored, but recovered morphology no longer provides a clean activity-noun derivation.
cross_candidate_findings.implication: B11 must choose retain-as-primitive, revise semantics/rationale, or retire.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: HOYU is the strongest phonological-metadata debt in the authored registry.

cross_candidate_findings.finding: No immediate deletion is justified by A8.
